Does anyone have any good ideas for how Voat could build systems where the potential for human shittiness is removed from the equation? institutional transparency? Let's see...

Power users: What are you proposing? As I understand it, a power user is a user who, over time, gains a lot of influence and, in that sphere of influence, importance, enabling them some persuasive power over others. If they choose, and some have, they can use that to manipulate. This one is easy. Speak up if you think you see someone doing it, refuse to be swayed, and don't give anyone a better response than anyone else just because of who they are. Ignore names, read the words. Judge on what's being said, not who's saying it, and act accordingly.

Can you elaborate on "flaws in the moderation system"? If you're talking hypothetically, you could PM Atko if you think you've found something seriously exploitable. If you mean specifics, it's not much good asking for responses if we don't know what you're referencing.

Vote manipulation...that is harder here. Limited votes, CCP needed to unlock downvoting, but it is possible. It's happened here before already. But can you prove it? Sometimes it's obvious, in which case, again, I suppose the solution would be to contact Atko. Other than that, all I think an individual can do is use their own voting power.

Propaganda is difficult. It's not black and white. What people class as propaganda can vary a lot. I think it should be allowed, but equally people should be allowed to have a go at it. Obviously. Besdies, if you have a go at propaganda for being one-sided, you'd have to have a go at a lot of news sources, too. I think it's best to allow it, so long as it's not all that's being posted; I think most people are intelligent enough to see through it.

The last one..basically, advertising? I'm not sure. I suppose they have their place.I think it'll be a problem if it's adverts pretending not to be adverts. You know, like one of those old dramas where they're in the middle of a conversation and as "Hey, I'm gonna get a drink of COLA, would you like some? I also have some FANTA if you like." If it's an advert, it should be clear, I think. I dislike it when people pretend they're contributing normally but are just promoting themselves. If you want to show your work off, fine, just don't pretend you're not and don't manipulate the votes.
